headline: As of 2026-10-26: 30,396,676 early/mail ballots cast nationally across 48 of 50 states, D+11.1 cast-ballot lean.
bullets: 30,396,676 early/mail ballots cast so far across 48 states reporting.
Across party-registration states, ballots cast lean D+11.1 by registration.
Most ballots cast: Texas (4,557,449), California (3,160,419), Florida (2,953,732).
